what: A second game process of the long training run started at 06:54 aborted on a damaged heap while the search freed the nodes of a game's tree that it did not keep; no game of that process had failed; the run replaced the process and lost only that process's games.

run.engine_and_search_sources_same_as: 999c90c (no change under src/, include/ or setup.py)
run.initial_models: generation 13 of the run of 19 November (commit 999c90c)
run.game_slots_of_a_process: group g plays slots 42g to 42g+41 (_GameProcess.group in studies/campaign/shared_evaluator.py); the six processes were started in group order, PIDs 7796 to 7801

failed_games_order_note: manifest.json lists failed games in the order the training process read them, with the index of the batch between two network updates; batch index 7 runs from network update 7 (14:08:57) to update 8 (15:18:34), and its only failed games are the 42 lost with process 7799. The run's only other failed games are those of batch index 3: two state-check failures in slots 182 and 206, which process 7800 played, and the 42 games lost with process 7800 (second_game_process_crash_2026_11_20.json). So no game of process 7799, which played slots 126 to 167, failed in its 7.56 hours.

crash.parent_is: the training process (studies.campaign.run train), which runs the inference server
crash.game_slots: 126 to 167 (group 3; the six processes were started in group order, PIDs 7796 to 7801)
